source: Actual local synthetic invoice workflow screenshots; generated Windows speech narration; automated test-wallet bridge, no real funds

scenes.title: Duplera: a local synthetic-data demonstration
scenes.narration: Duplera is a blockchain registry for duplicate invoice financing claims. This walkthrough uses synthetic invoices, a local E V M chain, and automated test wallets. It does not transfer money or prove that a trade is authentic.

scenes.title: Invoice extraction and explainable review
scenes.narration: The original PDF is processed in the browser. The lender confirms its fields, then the service checks stable business identity and explained similarity signals. Possible relationships require a recorded review. A similarity score is a heuristic, not a fraud probability.

scenes.title: An authoritative financing claim
scenes.narration: The lender signs the reservation and financing confirmation. The contract checks membership, a context bound analysis signature, nonce replay and active claim exclusivity. The immutable claim stores the evidence commitment. Financing remains active until this lender explicitly releases it.

scenes.title: A second lender encounters an exact conflict
scenes.narration: A second lender submits the same invoice. The live registry reports an active exact claim, so a new reservation is blocked. This protection is enforced by the contract, including for direct callers. Public observers still see token equality, addresses and timing.

scenes.title: Selective evidence and canonical inclusion
scenes.narration: The owner discloses only selected fields with their salted Merkle proofs. Verification checks the recorded root, reservation transaction and canonical block. A separate command line verifier can do this directly through R P C, without the application database.

scenes.title: Tampering fails verification
scenes.narration: Changing a disclosed value makes verification fail. This establishes consistency with what was committed. It does not establish supplier authenticity, legal priority, hidden field matching or a real payment. The synthetic benchmark also records false alerts and known detection misses.

scenes.title: Saved history and recovery
scenes.narration: The signed session and private workspace recover after a reload. Transaction receipts are reconciled with the chain, and pending, failed, dropped and reorganised transactions remain distinct. The full local acceptance suite and measured reports are included in the repository.
